purpose: Compare naturalistic VIZZ quality traces offline without turning them into gaze ground truth or a calibration profile.

activities.label: audit paired naturalistic traces without camera access or causal overclaim

queries.question: Can VIZZ compare two naturalistic quality traces while preserving privacy and explicitly refusing blink, gaze-target and lens-causality claims?

assumptions: The quality trace schema contains summaries rather than raw video or screen content.
The Windows display boundaries supplied to the auditor come from the 050 layout probe.
Mouse position is an auxiliary covariate and not gaze truth.
Naturalistic condition comparisons remain confounded by session, pose, distance and task.
kill_tests: Missing explicit blink fields do not become a blink count.
Pointer region is not interpreted as gaze monitor identity.
No camera, network or screen mutation occurs.
unknowns: Whether blink events were tolerated without a visible quality loss.
Which monitor the user actually looked at during a naturalistic movie task.
Whether any difference between conditions survives a balanced repeated design.
